programme.desc: Apabila sekumpulan remaja dalam kemusnahan kewangan memutuskan untuk merompak kedai antik tempatan, mereka menemui sebuah kubur kayu lama yang mengandungi mayat Mumia dan azimat purba. Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP7
programme.desc: Memaparkan Syamil dan Lisa menghubungi polis selepas mereka menemui mayat Pak Samad semasa ke rumahnya. Syamil datang ke rumah Bakri selepas dihubungi oleh Nasrun bagi mengubati sakit Bakri, malangnya Azhar terlebih dahulu membawa Bakri ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk memulihkannya. Kesempatan itu digunakan oleh Afifa bagi menggunakan ilmu hitam secara dalaman ke atas Bakri, walaupun pada fizikalnya Bakri telah disembuhkan oleh Mbah Nira. Lisa marahkan Afifa kerana melepaskan Bakri dan Azhar balik kerana peluang yang ada tidak digunakan bagi mereka membalas dendam. Di rumah, Bakri sekali lagi di rasuk sehingga hampir membunuh Azhar. Nasrun terpaksa menghubungi Syamil untuk memulihkan Bakri dengan menggunakan pendekatan Islamik. Akibatnya, Afifa terkesan dan hampir mati.

programme.title: Petualangan Anak Penangkap Hantu

programme.title: Black S2 EP8
programme.desc: Black dan Sofia keluar janji temu seharian. Tapi kebahagiaan hilang apabila 007 dan 416 membawa berita buruk buat Black - orang atasan tidak gembira dengan kurangnya kemajuan yang dibuat oleh Black. programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. programme.desc: Myeong-seob ditahan tetapi Dong-man terus cuba melepaskan diri dengan kuasanya. Han-shin membentangkan bukti penyalahgunaan sistem parol oleh Ojung Group. Akhirnya, Dong-man didakwa dan Han-shin terus berjuang untuk mereformasikan sistem parol.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP8
programme.desc: Imbas kembali beberapa tahun lalu semasa Lisa, Sara dan Afifa tinggal bersama Mbah Nira. Namun Sara mati, bagaimanapun Mbah Nira menggunakan ilmu hitamnya menjadikan Sara sebagai "Saka". Mbah Nira menurunkan ilmu hitamnya kepada Lisa dan Afifa. Kali ini, Cairyl dan Azhar bertindak menculik Afifa dan Lisa, mereka mendesak Lisa dan Afifa supaya mengarahkan Mbah Nira membebaskan Bakri daripada terus disihirkan. Tiba-tiba muncul “Saka” Sara menyebabkan Cairyl dan Azhar melarikan diri. Lisa dan Afifa balik ke rumah Mbah Nira, diketahui ilmu hitam yang dimiliki oleh Lisa lebih kuat berbanding Afifa. Bakri akhirnya meninggal. Nasrun merayu pertolongan Syamil, meminta Mbah Nira melepaskannya daripada disihirkan. Lisa bertindak menggunakan “Saka” Sara ke atas Azhar dan Cairyl.

programme.title: Midnight Show
programme.desc: Naya, Juna, Sarah dan seluruh pengunjung bioskop terlibat dalam misteri pembunuhan di sebuah bioskop tua pada tayangan tengah malam (midnight). Pembunuhan terjadi saat bioskop sedang memutarkan film kontroversial tentang seorang anak umur 12 tahun yang membunuh dan memutilasi seluruh keluarganya.

Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

Tanpa mengetahui, Adawiyah dan Diana adalah orang yang sama. Diana pernah terlibat dengan kemalangan dan sejak itu hidupnya berubah sepenuhnya.

Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

Betapa terkejutnya Raisa apabila mendapati bahawa Raffi (Alex Rio) adalah bakal suami kakaknya (Djihan Ranti). Walaupun begitu, Raisa berusaha untuk menyembunyikan hal tersebut.

Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina (Naomi Zaskia) dan berkenalan dengan Reza (Randy Pangalila), sementara tekanan daripada Pramana (Adipura) terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Suami Pertama Meninggalkan Luka, Suami Kedua Menyulut Bara
programme.desc: Hancur hati Dita (Kenya Nindia) apabila mengetahui suaminya, Joni (Rizal Akbar) berselingkuh dengan Re (Larasati Kusnandar), yang merupakan teman sekolahnya dahulu. Dita semakin terluka apabila Joni lebih memilih Re dan meninggalkannya. Setelah tiga tahun menjanda, akhirnya Dita berkahwin semula dengan Dio (Zidni Hakim). Namun keadaan semakin rumit apabila Joni dan Re tidak dapat menerima Dita yang hidup bahagia dan berniat untuk menghancurkan rumah tangga Dita dan Dio.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG (Kwok Chun On) saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAM's (Wu Fung) business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG (Pat Poon). Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONG's son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU (Chow Lai Ki, Niki), with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT (Frankie Lam), faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANG's wife CHEUNG MING-HEI (Tavia Yeung), CHUNG-YAM's grandson FONG CHAK-YU (Benjamin Yuen) and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI (Chau Pak Ho) also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry……

She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded & What's On Today
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. Shaun Tam, Hera Chan, ,Kirby Lam and Carina Leung become investigators in the "Critical Care Unit," searching far and wide for clues, evidence, and witnesses to unravel the mysteries surrounding various deadly diseases. Senior doctors and scholars from major public and private hospitals in Hong Kong, as well as local university medical schools, combine real case studies and medical images to make complex medical knowledge relatable, enabling the public to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the diagnosis and treatment of serious illnesses, reducing misunderstandings and fear, and encouraging Hong Kong residents to get early checkups and timely treatment to safeguard their future health.

programme.title: Walking With You
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare "girls' getaway," filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. They visited durian orchards to enjoy fresh Musang King durians, picked vegetables and coconuts in vegetable gardens, explored the rainforest, and visited luxurious houses, experiencing a different side of Malaysia. The four friends also shared heartfelt conversations with their guests, revealing their true selves.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu (Samantha Ko) suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai (Jonathan Cheung). She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man (Rosita Kwok), and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can “take over” her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Scoop 2026

programme.title: The Inner Eye & What's On Today
programme.desc: When “The Inner Eye “follows Shenzhen lawyer Tang Yingying as she handles a series of controversial cases and gradually transforms from someone driven by victory and profit into a lawyer who rediscovers her professional conscience. Through cases involving sexual assault allegations, inheritance disputes, emotional and medical conflicts, domestic violence, and public opinion against lawyers, she witnesses the darkness and vulnerability of human nature. As the lives of Dai Peilin, Lin Xiaoyun, Kang Jun, Fang Weian and others intertwine with hers, Tang learns to “cover her eyes” and listen to her inner sense of justice and integrity, ultimately finding her own rebirth in law, love and life.

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK$25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes… Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian (Qiao Xin), a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban life's hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili (Ma Sichao)! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other…!

Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him (Kenneth Ma), with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. Shaun Tam, Hera Chan, ,Kirby Lam and Carina Leung become investigators in the "Critical Care Unit," searching far and wide for clues, evidence, and witnesses to unravel the mysteries surrounding various deadly diseases. Senior doctors and scholars from major public and private hospitals in Hong Kong, as well as local university medical schools, combine real case studies and medical images to make complex medical knowledge relatable, enabling the public to gain a more comprehensive understanding of the diagnosis and treatment of serious illnesses, reducing misunderstandings and fear, and encouraging Hong Kong residents to get early checkups and timely treatment to safeguard their future health.

programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian (Qiao Xin), a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban life's hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili (Ma Sichao)! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other…!

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK$25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes… Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the company brings in MAN NIM-SUM (Frankie Lam), a marketing visionary, to be her equal! Thus begins the power struggle fueled by hatred and ego between the ex-couple. LING MAN handpicks a beautiful trainee from Shanghai called TIAN MI (Samantha Ko), who knows her way around men, to spy on NIM-SUM, without knowing that TIAN MI covets not only her job but also her man, triggering another cut-throat competition! On the other hand, YU-KEN uncovers the affair of her philandering boyfriend HO CHI-CHIU (Lai Lok Yi). Feeling downhearted and blue, she encounters the most caring guy named CHING YAT-FAI (Vincent Wong). Thinking their relationship will blossom into love, she surprisingly finds out that YAT-FAI's sweet and feminine cousin from Taiwan confesses her affection to him. YU-KEN's effort instantly pales in comparison with hers! To make matters worse, YAT-FAI seems to have suffered from gamophobia, rendering YU-KEN hopeless of getting married. Can these two dominant ladies devoid of femininity turn the tide to find their “Happily Ever After”?

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage. Siu shockingly finds out Alex is a mirage! Welcome to the 1960s and Coco (Selena Lee) is a hostess at Twilight Ballroom. She dreams of becoming an air hostess someday. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. Her fantastic dream is even adapted as a novel by bookstore owner Lam Yeuk-sze (Bob Cheung). Siu accidentally finds this novel from yesteryear as he just has to get to the bottom of the mystery. Siu is aghast when he finds out he and Alex had been destined to get intertwined in some previous life.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne of MAN. FUNG loses his memory on a mission and has turned from a cruel person into a man with sympathy. PRINCESS WING-YEUNG (Elanne Kwong) never likes brocade guards. She tells PO, a good friend of hers, to guard against FUNG. MAN still thinks very highly of FUNG, but FUNG has become distrustful since his accident. And for reason he does not know, he finds the mysterious SHUM TSIN-SAM (Kate Tsui) and TAI, who is a deep person, very familiar. Later when he comes to know a secret on a mission to kill TAI, he is caught in a dilemma of feeling angry and guilty.

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: Following the death of his co-worker, CHEUK HOI (Michael Mui) discovers that five undercover officers have lost. All of them possess confidential information. CHEUK HOI needs to find them immediately……

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

Welcome to the 1960s and Coco (Selena Lee) is a hostess at Twilight Ballroom. She dreams of becoming an air hostess someday. She falls in love with Lau Yuk-fai (Joel Chan), who is a policeman and a dead ringer for some guy in her dream. Her fantastic dream is even adapted as a novel by bookstore owner Lam Yeuk-sze (Bob Cheung). Siu accidentally finds this novel from yesteryear as he just has to get to the bottom of the mystery. Siu is aghast when he finds out he and Alex had been destined to get intertwined in some previous life.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne of MAN. FUNG loses his memory on a mission and has turned from a cruel person into a man with sympathy. PRINCESS WING-YEUNG (Elanne Kwong) never likes brocade guards. She tells PO, a good friend of hers, to guard against FUNG. MAN still thinks very highly of FUNG, but FUNG has become distrustful since his accident. And for reason he does not know, he finds the mysterious SHUM TSIN-SAM (Kate Tsui) and TAI, who is a deep person, very familiar. Later when he comes to know a secret on a mission to kill TAI, he is caught in a dilemma of feeling angry and guilty.

programme.title: Always And Ever
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his eyes. According to BAO ZHENG's investigation, SEUNG-SEUNG was actually a princess, but was instead framed by a villain, GAO JIAN (Ben Wong). Shedding his tears, BAO ZHENG is forced to execute SEUNG-SEUNG, triggering his soul to once again float out of his body to the 1950s, when he becomes an all-powerful inspector WAH LUNG-BIU (Bobby Au Yeung). As predestined, he believes he will re-encounter TSIK-SUET, yet TIN TSAU-FUNG (Esther Kwan), who is standing in front of him, does not recall him at all. On the contrary, she thinks he is the one who killed her husband. In order to change his fate, LUNG-BIU continuously verifies the truth. Unexpectedly, he learns that a dancer, LAM YIM-FONG (Rebecca Zhu) and her boyfriend YUEN KWAI (Pierre Ngo), are his biological parents. Moreover, TIN TSAU-FUNG's younger sister TIN TSAU-NGAN (Mandy Wong) turns out to be manipulating the whole plot. Tragedy recurs when LUNG-BIU accidentally kills TSAU-FUNG again. With KAM-CHEONG's soul returning to the modern era, he is determined to ferret out the one who has cast the spell on him in the cycle of reincarnation so as to protect TSIK-SUET as well as to escape from the curse. However, to his surprise, it is him initiating all these tragedies......

programme.title: Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUNG (So Yuk Wa, Louisa) to control TIGER and misleads LEUNG that TIGER is her long lost rescuer. Using tricks to upset TIGER, he makes TIGER marry LEUNG. Since then, LEUNG tries every means to domesticate her husband and that almost drives him insane. BUN is relieved to escape from TIGER's manipulation but he carelessly causes lots of troubles elsewhere… “A Bride for A Ride” brings you a modern perspective of this traditional tale and you'll surely be surprised with its astonishing approach.

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the company brings in MAN NIM-SUM (Frankie Lam), a marketing visionary, to be her equal! Thus begins the power struggle fueled by hatred and ego between the ex-couple. LING MAN handpicks a beautiful trainee from Shanghai called TIAN MI (Samantha Ko), who knows her way around men, to spy on NIM-SUM, without knowing that TIAN MI covets not only her job but also her man, triggering another cut-throat competition! On the other hand, YU-KEN uncovers the affair of her philandering boyfriend HO CHI-CHIU (Lai Lok Yi). Feeling downhearted and blue, she encounters the most caring guy named CHING YAT-FAI (Vincent Wong). Thinking their relationship will blossom into love, she surprisingly finds out that YAT-FAI's sweet and feminine cousin from Taiwan confesses her affection to him. YU-KEN's effort instantly pales in comparison with hers! To make matters worse, YAT-FAI seems to have suffered from gamophobia, rendering YU-KEN hopeless of getting married. Can these two dominant ladies devoid of femininity turn the tide to find their “Happily Ever After”?

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu & his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Cliff Walkers
programme.desc: The first spy thriller movie by famous Director Zhang Yi Mou, this film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932. Sold out by a traitor, the agents, who split up into two teams, find themselves surrounded by threats on all sides. Can they complete their mission?

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his son's talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husband's departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other?

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize. However, what Kao and other contestants do not realize is that there is a fierce and deadly beast lurking underground who wants to eat them all!

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple
programme.desc: Raised in the bustle of New York, Sarah is sent to Malaysia to live with her grandfather due to her mother's work. To her, it feels like falling into an unfamiliar world. In a strange neighbourhood, she hides her loneliness behind a guarded, superior attitude. Over time, however, grandfather and granddaughter grow closer, gradually opening their hearts to each other.

programme.title: Panda Plan: The Magical Tribe
programme.desc: Panda Hu Hu and superstar Jackie are transported to a mysterious, isolated tribe, where Hu Hu is revered as a sacred guardian. As secrets emerge, can Hu Hu save the tribe from crisis?

programme.title: Operation Hadal
programme.desc: An elite deep-sea special forces unit teams up with the submarine “Long Jing” to thwart an international super-submarine conspiracy. Facing enemy ambushes and navigating treacherous waters, they dive into a dangerous underwater battlefield, where a life-or-death showdown unfolds beneath the sea.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing has been able to see ghosts since young. When his mother's suicide attempt forces him to return to Hong Kong and the home he ran away from, he discovers that the horrific visions that once haunted him have become worse. Caught between the living and the dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A killer and a stage actor accidentally swapped their identities at a bathhouse. The actor must complete the killer's mission while the killer thinks he is a hopeless actor after losing his memory during the accident. When the killer strives to become a successful stage actor, he also starts to recall what has happened…

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: All U Need Is Love
programme.desc: Ten major film companies join forces on a comedy-drama film to raise funds and create jobs for industry workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. This film features an all-star ensemble cast starring for free, with the story revolving around a group of hotel guests placed under quarantine in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: Big Times For The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, & colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Bhaagamathie
programme.desc: Chanchala Reddy, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

programme.title: Idhu Ennoda Jilla
programme.desc: A young man seeks revenge for his father's death but learns that violence isn't the answer. His life changes when he meets a young woman who helps him rediscover himself.

programme.title: Ka Pae Ranasingam
programme.desc: Ariyanachi, a poor woman, strives to bring her deceased husband's body back to India from Dubai, battling the odds of political agenda, corruption and a treacherous bureaucracy that stand in her way.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Arjun
programme.desc: Two neighbours and childhood friends who share a love-hate relationship with each other find themselves in a loveless marriage.

programme.title: Yaanai
programme.desc: In Ramnad, PRV juggles life with his two wives and kids while facing blame from another family for his brother's death. Tensions rise as their stories intertwine.

programme.title: Dinosaurs
programme.desc: The film revolves around two rival gangster families vying for control of the city. Their ongoing feud forms the core conflict of the story.

programme.title: Kaadan
programme.desc: Kaadan, a forest-raised man, vows to protect the jungle and its wildlife when he discovers a politician's plan to destroy it for a township.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Maniyaar Kudumbam
programme.desc: Kutti Maniyar avoids working and lives off his inherited money and property. However, he decides to turn over a new leaf when he falls in love.
